langtext_en: An invoice is an administrative document that is widely used in the context of international business and can vary in format according to company policy.

langtext_en: On the other hand, invoice is an Indonesian term that is often used in the context of taxation.
langtext_id: Di sisi lain, faktur adalah istilah dalam bahasa Indonesia yang sering kali digunakan dalam konteks perpajakan.

langtext_en: Invoices in Indonesia not only include transaction information like invoices, but also additional elements for tax purposes, such as the Tax Invoice Serial Number and the NPWP of the seller and buyer.
